svg.title: Drawing 01 — Existing and proposed street elevations — Finnieston Shopfront & Upper Floors
svg.desc: Existing survey elevation with a patched fascia, a blocked bay and altered stallrisers beside the proposed elevation with a new shopfront composition set out from the structural bays, a defined signage zone and keyed stone repairs.
